description: The open data portal of SE-CONRED, the executive secretariat of the Guatemalan National Coordinator for Disaster Reduction, publishes nine datasets for research, visualisations and applications. They include verified incidents, that is risk, emergency or disaster situations in Guatemala or abroad that required the CONRED system, as yearly files from 2008 to 2024; housing damage assessments, such as those for storms Eta and Iota in 2020 by department; wildfire pre-suppression and suppression records; the coordinators for disaster reduction and the municipal integrated risk management bodies; inter-agency documents; budget execution; and geographic data with landslide and flood hazard rasters for use in GIS software. Tables are offered as CSV, JSON, XLSX and XML, and the portal runs on CKAN with an API. Access is free; the datasets carry the GNU Free Documentation License. Caveats: the portal is in Spanish, the incident files are split by year, and the hazard rasters come as ZIP archives. Coverage is Guatemala. It supports hazard exposure analysis, calibration of damage models and emergency response studies for housing, roads and other infrastructure; related records are DesInventar Sendai and the Mexico Atlas Nacional de Riesgos.
